aggregation: median nine timing repetitions within source/cap/seed/policy; mean four seeds; equal source-parent mean; fixed TRAIN model

within_root_residual_dependence.interpretation: Descriptive symmetrized pair moments, equal parent weighting. No independence test or population-general claim; TRAIN is fixed.

inference_scope: Paired source-parent bootstrap stratified by ply, conditional on fixed TRAIN. Shared game descendants can couple source parents; this is a finite held-out cohort comparison and does not establish universal iid game performance.
